core.title: 12-1/2 Inch Canterbury Hand Forged Iron Door Pull, Acorn IPEBP
tags: acorn hand forged iron door pull

text.description_html:
Acorn IPEBP, Hand Forged Iron Canterbury Door Pull

This iron pull gives an old world charm to any home door, gate, or garage door. It has a rope or bundle style grip. Sturdy and long lasting, it can be used indoors as well as out. It has a rustic feel from a time when a blacksmith would hand-forge hardware so that this hearty pull exudes an old world charm onto any door. Acorn made, the IPEBP measures 12-1/2 inches high and has a black iron finish that looks like it comes straight from the old world.

Iron Art is a unique line of products created by using the techniques of the traditional forge. Each piece is fabricated with a rare craftsmanship reminiscent of a time when expert artisans, hammer in hand, transformed pure iron into simple yet functional designs. The result is individual works of art made in an old world style. We are proud to offer these high quality pieces to complement your home.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications for the Canterbury Hand Forged Iron Door Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 12-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 3-1/2"

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application. This door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
